work_window_utc.meaning: One parallel implementation batch with nonoverlapping new files, followed by serial new-only inert checks. Not live runtime or acceptance performance.

implementation: Fixed root launcher drops to existing broker identity and invokes one five-second bounded publisher child inside the exact owned fixture. The child reuses the broker atomic publication primitive under a verified nonblocking regular-file lock.

Publisher derives the active skill from the pinned policy's sole existing allow rule; policy, target and payload remain unchanged. One fresh 15-second revocation advances the persisted generation floor and retains canonical policy/revocation/state before and after.

Existing health and observation publication are not changed. No revocation service or response chain starts. Publication does not imply a later decision, sole-cause denial, pre-effect prevention or freshness at an arbitrary later time.

Fixed workload wrapper binds common28 installed identity, expected worker/broker/gateway epochs, held handles for all four active processes, actual action path/payload and original genesis. It holds the independent sink and requires an empty native receipt stream.

An absent-only local attempt directory/input is persisted before one publication and one bounded driver invocation. Actual returned BLOCK must contain ACTIVE_SKILL_REVOKED and the exact published digest/generation; no different target or payload is substituted.

Actual driver output readback, complete two-record receipt snapshot, sink after observation, process continuity, common identity and source checks are retained independently after failure. A partial chain is a refusal and cannot trigger an alternate-count retry.

Held preactivation handoff joins the original collection preparation and attributed schedule request to the actual seven-writer common deployment and broker measurement plan. It source-inspects the fixed real workload, independent verifier and identity reader without invoking them.

Actual claim clock and existing shared permanent claim namespace precede one broker-input provisioning operation. This context consumes the entire original commitment for one attributed attempt; it is not a 100-attempt campaign collector, resumable setup, generic mark adapter or activation authority.

Outer controller must keep the context in an outer ExitStack through activation/workload/cleanup. Failed provisioning before yield still triggers independent claim/source/request/private-input/public-output/fixture checks. Only detached public records are exposed; private grant/input blobs must not be blanket-exported.
review_findings_resolved: Unbounded subprocess.run stdout capture was replaced before testing with a fixed capped selector drain, zero tolerated stderr, deadline and owned process-group cleanup; complete public child reports survive nonzero exit or interruption.
Publication lock is opened O_NONBLOCK and checked as a single-link regular file before acquiring the existing lock, avoiding FIFO blocking before the outer deadline.

Final handoff custody checks originally covered only a yielded context; they now cover the entire postclaim path, including provisioner and retention failures, and run independently instead of short-circuiting.
Workload final sink diagnostics now survive sink-context cleanup failure, and actual output readback is attempted after failed invocation without retry.

A post-read KeyboardInterrupt could be replaced by a later missing-output or cleanup exception. The original primary is preserved, all final reads still run, and the bounded report is attached before re-raising.

Independent cross-module review confirmed actual sink, common identity, native zero-to-two receipt and broker revocation fields match the new wrapper. Fixed source pins and predecessor environment values were read back rather than guessed.

reviewed_input_closure.extra_handoff_data_closure: Union with reviewed native-common-preparation inputs because its data constructor stages the actual common profile and reads the retained baseline capture/configuration. No historical test method is inherited, discovered or invoked.
reviewed_input_closure.limits: Static AST import review and explicit data closure are local developer evidence, not complete environment/dependency or loaded-code attestation.

next_dependency: Reuse the current common host/guest setup hook to build the actual original commitment/request and broker plan inside one first-activation controller. Keep the new handoff in an outer ExitStack, invoke the fixed workload once while collecting both external clock reads in one process, retain actual ingress/effective broker records, run independent consumers, export only explicit public evidence, and clean up the owned services/fixture. Setup-only captures stay non-resumable. Remaining admission, RUN/sensor health, actual campaign inventory and complete verifier mapping precede final freeze and acceptance.
checkpoint_commit: Create one signed local commit, verify signature and working-tree state, and retain actual hash in ignored .aragorn/phase3-batch-<short-hash>-checkpoint.json. No automatic push.
